title: fix(metadata-protocol): resolve the promoted draft under its ADR-0048 package dimension
body:
Fixes #8907

## The defect

`publishPackageDrafts` lists a package's pending drafts with
`repo.listDrafts({ packageId })` — a `package_id = :packageId` filter — then promotes each
listed row through `promoteDraftForPublish` into `repo.promoteDraft`. `promoteDraft`
re-resolved the row with `whereFor(ref, 'draft')`, which **omits the ADR-0048 `package_id`
dimension**. Overlay rows are keyed by `(org, type, name, package_id)` precisely so two
installed packages shipping the same name keep separate rows, so that lookup cannot tell
them apart.

Measured consequence, reproduced independently in the new pin: publishing `app.demo`
promoted **app.other's** unreviewed pending draft to active, drained app.other's draft row,
recorded it under app.demo's ADR-0067 commit — and left app.demo's own edit pending, while
answering `success: true`. Which of the two rows won was driver-order dependent.

## The fix

Thread the listed row's `package_id` from `listDrafts` through `promoteDraftForPublish`
into `promoteDraft`, mirroring the existing `draftOrgId` threading for the #3115
org-partition analogue. `whereFor` already accepted the dimension, so this states a value
rather than adding a query shape.

**The drain is fixed with it** — the other half of the card's title. `promoteDraft` now
drops the row it actually promoted, using that row's own binding. An unscoped drain re-runs
the same ambiguous lookup, so it can delete a different package's draft; and when the two
bodies differ it instead trips the optimistic-lock mismatch that `draftDrainVerdict`
classifies as the benign "a newer draft was saved" race and silences — leaving the
just-published draft pending forever. That limb is separately ablated below.

Callers that name no package (`publishMetaItem`) are unchanged: an omitted `packageId`
keeps the historical "match any package" resolution. `packageId` on the repository's
`delete` is a local extension exactly as `state` already is — the shared `DeleteOptions`
contract in `metadata-core` is untouched, so no other `MetadataRepository` implementation
is affected.

## Out of scope, deliberately

The card's question about the **other** "match any package" resolving reads (the
user-facing `delete` verb, and `restoreVersion` — #6215) is **reported, not acted on**.
`whereFor`'s comment now records the question instead of asserting the answer it used to.

## Verification

Union run at HEAD `843ca40aa` (the merge commit, i.e. this branch's final commit).

**The pin can fail — ablated, both limbs:**

- Pre-fix, the new pin failed exactly as the card measured: active row
  `expected 'app.demo', received 'app.other'`, and the surviving draft
  `expected 'app.other', received 'app.demo'`.
- Ablating **only** the drain scoping (leaving the resolving-read fix in place) produced the
  predicted, different failure: the promote case stayed green and the drain case went red
  with `expected [ ... ] to have a length of 1 but got 2` — both drafts surviving, i.e. the
  silent benign-conflict path. That proves the drain limb is independently load-bearing and
  not a rider.

The ablation is source-level (the suite imports `./protocol.js`, which vitest resolves from
`src`), so no `dist` rebuild is involved in it. The `dist`-resolving consumer,
`packages/qa/dogfood`, ran against a full closure rebuilt after the fix.

Consumers are the **downstream** direction (`pnpm --filter '...@objectstack/metadata-protocol'`,
prefix form), scoped to the seam's real consumption radius rather than all 44 dependents.

Gates, all green at the same HEAD: `check:nul-bytes`, `check:engine-double-contract`
(the new fake engine is **pinned**, 270 pinned — no ledger entry needed),
`check:durability-log-level`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:filter-alias-parity`,
`check:query-options-erasure`, `check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt --re-measure`
(33 entries, 1926 raw errors, **none above its recorded number**; `metadata-protocol` stays at
its recorded 63, so the new test file adds zero tsc errors). The one reported surplus is
`@objectstack/lint` at -1, pre-existing and untouched by this diff.

The last four families beyond the dispatch prompt's list were re-derived from the actual
changed paths via `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`.

## Declared-region note for the reviewer

The dispatch declared `protocol.ts` region `promoteDraftForPublish` only. One edit lands
outside it: the call site in `publishPackageDrafts` that passes `packageId: d.packageId`.
It is structurally unavoidable — `listDrafts` is called there, so "thread the listed row's
`package_id` from `listDrafts` through `promoteDraftForPublish`" cannot be done without it,
and the other two edits are inert dead code without it. It is ~9,200 lines from the one live
sibling's region (#8855 at `getMetaDiagnostics`), so it keeps the same conflict-safety
property the region declaration exists for. Flagged rather than assumed.
